description: This file defines an interface for policy modification commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends a general PolicyCommand interface and includes a method to set Ditto headers, indicating it relates to commands that modify policy state.

classes.name: PolicyModifyCommand
classes.description: An interface representing commands that modify policies, supporting chaining and optional entity specification.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the command, returning the command instance for chaining.
